name: apps/perfmon
description: The performance monitor: the application, its tabs and components, the alert machinery, and a plugin per thing worth watching -- CPU, memory, heap, disks, network, processes, messages, module variables, the servers.
residual: Named 2026-08-24 out of packages/apps/README.md's list of candidates: twenty-odd modules that are one application, and the first of that list to become a manifest.
An application, so out of the payload; a plugin here is a module the monitor loads by name, which is why they are all named rather than left to a closure.
